comment: Utility methods for handling AAC audio streams.

variables.name: AAC_LC_AUDIO_SAMPLE_COUNT
variables.comment: * Number of raw audio samples that are produced per channel when decoding an AAC LC access unit.

variables.name: AAC_XHE_AUDIO_SAMPLE_COUNT
variables.comment: * Number of raw audio samples that are produced per channel when decoding an AAC XHE access unit.

variables.name: AAC_HE_AUDIO_SAMPLE_COUNT
variables.comment: * Number of raw audio samples that are produced per channel when decoding an AAC HE access unit.

variables.name: AAC_LD_AUDIO_SAMPLE_COUNT
variables.comment: * Number of raw audio samples that are produced per channel when decoding an AAC LD access unit.

variables.name: AAC_LC_MAX_RATE_BYTES_PER_SECOND
variables.comment: Maximum rate for an AAC LC audio stream, in bytes per second.

variables.name: AAC_HE_V1_MAX_RATE_BYTES_PER_SECOND
variables.comment: Maximum rate for an AAC HE V1 audio stream, in bytes per second.

variables.name: AAC_HE_V2_MAX_RATE_BYTES_PER_SECOND
variables.comment: Maximum rate for an AAC HE V2 audio stream, in bytes per second.

variables.name: AAC_XHE_MAX_RATE_BYTES_PER_SECOND
variables.comment:
* Maximum rate for an AAC XHE audio stream, in bytes per second. * *

Fraunhofer documentation says "500 kbit/s and above" for stereo, so we use a rate generously * above the 500 kbit/s level.

variables.name: AAC_ELD_MAX_RATE_BYTES_PER_SECOND
variables.comment:
* Maximum rate for an AAC ELD audio stream, in bytes per second. * *

Fraunhofer documentation shows AAC-ELD as useful for up to ~ 64 kbit/s so we use this value.

variables.name: AUDIO_SPECIFIC_CONFIG_CHANNEL_COUNT_TABLE
variables.comment:
* In the channel configurations below, <A> indicates a single channel element; (A, B) * indicates a channel pair element; and [A] indicates a low-frequency effects element. The * speaker mapping short forms used are: * *
    *
  • FC: front center *
  • BC: back center *
  • FL/FR: front left/right *
  • FCL/FCR: front center left/right *
  • FTL/FTR: front top left/right *
  • SL/SR: back surround left/right *
  • BL/BR: back left/right *
  • LFE: low frequency effects *

variables.name: CODECS_STRING_PREFIX
variables.comment:
* Prefix for the RFC 6381 codecs string for AAC formats. To form a full codecs string, suffix the
   * decimal AudioObjectType.

variables.name: AUDIO_OBJECT_TYPE_ESCAPE
variables.comment: Escape code for extended audio object types.

methods.name: public static Config parseAudioSpecificConfig(byte[] audioSpecificConfig) throws ParserException
methods.comment:
* Parses an AAC AudioSpecificConfig, as defined in ISO 14496-3 1.6.2.1
   *
   * @param audioSpecificConfig A byte array containing the AudioSpecificConfig to parse.
   * @return The parsed configuration.
   * @throws ParserException If the AudioSpecificConfig cannot be parsed because it is invalid or
   *     unsupported.

methods.name: public static Config parseAudioSpecificConfig(ParsableBitArray bitArray, boolean forceReadToEnd) throws ParserException
methods.comment:
* Parses an AAC AudioSpecificConfig, as defined in ISO 14496-3 1.6.2.1
   *
   * @param bitArray A {@link ParsableBitArray} containing the AudioSpecificConfig to parse. The
   *     position is advanced to the end of the AudioSpecificConfig.
   * @param forceReadToEnd Whether the entire AudioSpecificConfig should be read. Required for
   *     knowing the length of the configuration payload.
   * @return The parsed configuration.
   * @throws ParserException If the AudioSpecificConfig cannot be parsed because it is invalid or
   *     unsupported.

   * @param sampleRate The sample rate in Hz.

   * @param channelConfig The channel configuration.

methods.name: private static int getAudioObjectType(ParsableBitArray bitArray)
methods.comment:
* Returns the AAC audio object type as specified in 14496-3 (2005) Table 1.14.
   *
   * @param bitArray The bit array containing the audio specific configuration.
   * @return The audio object type.

methods.comment:

   * (2005) Table 1.13.
   *
   * @param bitArray The bit array containing the audio specific configuration.
   * @return The sampling frequency.
   * @throws ParserException If the audio specific configuration is invalid.
